audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 2 and 4 disagree with the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: The mirrored graves__tryndamere audit flipped Level 1 to Tryndamere (Spinning Slash's 650 range opens on his 425 Quickdraw), Level 3 to Skill (the Smoke Screen window is real but conditional) and Level 6 to Skill. Rows 1, 3, 5 and 6 already agree across both layers and the packet chart, so they are untouched.
audit.corrected: Tryndamere, Graves, Skill, Tryndamere, Skill, Tryndamere, Tryndamere — rows 0, 2, 4 as matched full/content pairs with ratings inverted from the mirror's.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level-6 stage said only that R 'lets you survive his combo burst'; the sequencing that actually decides it was missing.
audit.why: Undying Rage denies Collateral Damage outright, so a Graves who knows the matchup simply holds his ult — 100s at rank 1 — until yours expires. Timing your R late closes his window with it.
audit.corrected: Time your R late so his window closes with it, not after it.

audit.whatIsWrong: New Destiny was never mentioned. Graves' bullets cannot pass through units — the single most exploitable property in his kit — and the page says nothing about it.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Attacks fire 4 bullets, which cannot pass through units.' A minion standing between you absorbs most of a shotgun blast, so how you approach him decides how much damage you take before you ever land a crit.
audit.corrected: His four bullets cannot pass through units — a single minion between you swallows most of a shotgun blast.

audit.whatIsWrong: Smoke Screen is called a 'blind' in four places — whys[1], spikes[0], wants.you[1] and wants.foe[1]. It is not a blind.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'creates a cloud of smoke that reduces sight range'. It nearsights and slows on impact; your autos still land at full damage on a target you can reach. Telling a Tryndamere to disengage from smoke costs him the trade he was winning.
audit.corrected: Smoke Screen reduces your sight, it does not blind your autos: keep attacking inside it.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[1] and spikes[0] name his Q 'Buckshot', and spikes[0]/spikes[3]/wants.you[0] refer to 'E dash charges'.
audit.why: His Q is End of the Line (13/11.25/9.5/7.75/6s, detonates after 1 second or instantly on terrain). Quickdraw is a single dash on 16/15/14/13/12s whose cooldown is shortened by landing basic attacks — it has no charges, and dashing toward a champion grants two stacks of True Grit instead of one.
audit.corrected: End of the Line detonates after 1 second, or instantly on terrain; Quickdraw is 16s at rank 1, cut by every auto he lands.

audit.whatIsWrong: End of the Line's terrain detonation was absent.
audit.why: Fighting him against a wall removes the 1-second delay you would otherwise have to walk out of.
audit.corrected: Near a wall his poke lands with no warning window.

edits.before: Spin up fury on the wave before contesting anything. Identify how Graves contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Take Spinning Slash first: its 650 range beats his 425 Quickdraw, so you choose when the level-1 trade starts and when it ends.

edits.before: Undying Rage makes you unkillable for 5 seconds — dives and coin-flip all-ins become yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Graves's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Undying Rage denies Collateral Damage, so a smart Graves holds his 100s ult until yours ends. Time your R late so his window closes with it, not after it.

edits.before: Level 1 is an even farm opener before Graves reaches his power spike.
edits.after: Level 1 your 650 Spinning Slash opens on him before he has burst.

edits.before: Level 2 belongs to Graves — Buckshot plus E burst and the W blind win the trade.
edits.after: Level 2 belongs to Graves — End of the Line plus his Quickdraw burst wins it.

edits.before: Graves' level-2 spike with Q Buckshot and E dash burst hurts, but once you have E Spinning Slash at 3+ you can dodge his Smoke Screen W blind and gap-close — commit only when his E dash charges are spent so he can't reposition out.
edits.after: End of the Line detonates after 1 second, or instantly on terrain — near a wall his poke lands with no warning window. Smoke Screen reduces your sight, it does not blind your autos: keep attacking inside it. Commit on Quickdraw's 16s cooldown.

edits.before: You out-duel Graves late — his damage is front-loaded and burst-shaped, so R eats his combo and your continuous crit autos plus Q healing win any extended fight once his E dashes are used.
edits.after: His shotgun fires four bullets that cannot pass through units, so a minion between you eats most of his damage — fight him on your side of the wave. Quickdraw is 16s but every auto he lands cuts it.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 swing on execution: your E all-in comes online and lets you close past his Smoke Screen, but his front-loaded damage keeps level 6 a coin-flip decided by whether you time R Undying Rage correctly.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 swing on execution: Spinning Slash's 650 range closes past his 425 Quickdraw, and his four bullets cannot pass through units, so approach with a minion between you. Level 6 turns on ult timing.

edits.before: Dodge Smoke Screen W so you aren't blinded mid-trade
edits.after: Keep autoing inside Smoke Screen — it fogs, not blinds

edits.before: Blind you with Smoke Screen W to negate your autos
edits.after: Fog you with Smoke Screen so you lose sight of him

edits.before: - Graves Quickdraw: matchup-defining — His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Quickdraw (E): 16s at rank 1, but every basic attack he lands shortens it — deny his autos and the dash stays down. - End of the Line (Q): 13s at rank 1, instant on terrain. - Collateral Damage: 100s at rank 1.

edits.before: His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Quickdraw is 16s at rank 1, and dashing at you grants him double True Grit resists.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Dashing into you doubles his True Grit resists — don't feed it.

edits.before: Track Graves's Quickdraw: His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. When it is down — Spin in, crit him down.
edits.after: His four bullets cannot pass through units — a single minion between you swallows most of a shotgun blast.
